props.name: children
props.description: Label content. When string is provided, automatically renders as Label.Text. Otherwise renders children as-is

props.name: isRequired
props.description: Whether the label is required. Shows asterisk indicator when true

props.name: isInvalid
props.description: Whether the label is in an invalid state. Changes text color to danger

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Whether the label is disabled. Applies disabled styling and prevents interaction

props.name: animation
props.description: Animation configuration. Use `"disable-all"` to disable all animations including children

props.name: ...PressableProps
props.description: All standard React Native Pressable props are supported

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes to apply to the text element

props.name: classNames
props.description: Additional CSS classes for different parts of the label

props.name: styles
props.description: Styles for different parts of the label

props.name: nativeID
props.description: Native ID for accessibility. Used to link label to form fields via aria-labelledby

props.name: ...TextProps
props.description: All standard React Native Text props are supported
